security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when predictor structures (FTB, TAGE-SC branch predictor, load-value predictor, stride prefetcher) tag entries with only a subset of hardware protection domain identifiers (e.g., ASID only without VMID when H extension is active, or privilege mode only without SDID when Smsdid is implemented), predictions learned in one hardware protection domain are incorrectly reused for speculative execution in a different domain. Additionally, if the fence.hpd instruction does not trigger a full pipeline drain and predictor invalidation for all entries matching the current and lower-privilege-level domain identifiers before allowing subsequent instructions to issue speculative accesses, stale cross-domain predictions persist.
security_spec.summary: Incomplete hardware protection domain identifier tagging in speculative predictor structures (branch predictor, prefetchers, load-value predictor) and missing pipeline synchronization on fence.hpd allow cross-domain transient execution attacks to leak data across privilege/VM/AS boundaries
